# Mozart

> Mozart is an AI coding agent manager: run, review, and orchestrate multiple Claude Code agents in parallel from a single desktop app.

Mozart wraps the Claude Code CLI and adds a visual layer for managing isolated workspaces, reviewing diffs, and tracking agent runs without touching Git internals.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://mozart.build/docs/introduction): What Mozart is and why it exists
- [Install](https://mozart.build/docs/install): Download and set up Mozart
- [First Workspace](https://mozart.build/docs/first-workspace): Run your first AI coding task
- [Isolated Workspaces](https://mozart.build/docs/concepts/isolated-workspaces): How Mozart sandboxes each agent run
- [Local-First](https://mozart.build/docs/concepts/local-first): Why Mozart runs on your machine
